Exact source publication dates are unknown where null. Last-checked time is not publication time.

signals.title: Reuse supported frontier orchestration before building a replacement
signals.fact: OpenAI documents scheduled tasks with skills and local project/worktree support, plus codex exec JSON events and schema-shaped final output. The SDK documents programmatic local threads.
signals.inference: Compare these supported surfaces with any proposed frontier dispatcher. A native deterministic Lawn timer still has a different role: it need not spend frontier credits or keep the app open.
signals.next_test: Read installed client version and account features without changing them; compare one existing supported scheduling/exec interface to the next proposed custom component.
signals.stop_if: The needed capability is unavailable in this account/version, cannot satisfy the permission boundary, or costs more attention than the existing deterministic path.
signals.runtime_fit: No runtime used. Local app tasks require computer/app availability; cloud tasks do not gain access to a home folder automatically. Subscription usage is not unlimited API capacity.
signals.reuse_notes: Reuse documented interfaces. Do not copy authentication stores, change current Lawn scheduling work, or assume docs establish local acceptance.

commercial_evidence.detail: No external demand, revenue, or measured time saving established by these documentation reads.

signals.title: Check the new built-in context continuity before writing another memory layer
signals.fact: The Astra launch page describes notes across context windows and retrieval of earlier context windows in Codex, presented as an experimental configuration feature.
signals.inference: This may address long-run continuity in the frontier client. It does not replace a durable, human-reviewed Ledger or local-worker journals.
signals.next_test: After the active job finishes, inspect the official linked configuration reference and installed version; propose a separate low-risk continuity check only if the feature is actually available.
signals.stop_if: The feature is unavailable, adds unintended data exposure, or the proposed memory work solves a different durable-evidence requirement.
signals.runtime_fit: Not enabled or tested here; availability and reliability remain unverified for the owner's installation.
signals.reuse_notes: Use supported configuration only after review. Do not copy another agent's private context or claim benchmark improvements from a launch article.

commercial_evidence.detail: No external demand, revenue, or measured time saving established by these documentation reads.

signals.title: Ollama already integrates with Codex; hardware and egress fit still matter
signals.fact: Ollama documents Codex CLI integration and recommends at least 64K context. Its current page also describes a signed-in web-search service for Codex requests using the Ollama profile.
signals.inference: An existing integration is worth knowing about, but it is not evidence that an 8 GB node should replace frontier orchestration or that all behavior stays local.
signals.next_test: Before any later integration proposal, compare installed versions, memory/context needs and web-search behavior with the approved local-only worker configuration.
signals.stop_if: It needs larger hardware, changes the current profile unexpectedly, or crosses the unresolved runtime/privacy boundary.
signals.runtime_fit: The current 4K worker experiments are not a 64K Codex-agent qualification. No model was downloaded or invoked.
signals.reuse_notes: Configuration examples are reference material, not commands for the scout to execute. Retain existing local worker and frontier profiles.

commercial_evidence.detail: No external demand, revenue, or measured time saving established by these documentation reads.

signals.title: Keep protocol integration version-aware rather than coding against an old roadmap
signals.fact: MCP maintainers' August 22 roadmap summarizes the July 28 specification changes and places agentic messaging, identity and result contracts among the next priorities; Tasks remain described as an extension.
signals.inference: Future delegation/discovery adapters should check the pinned client/server versions and released extension status, not assume an old implementation matches today's roadmap.
signals.next_test: At the next actual MCP integration change, map required capabilities against installed versions and current official spec; do not upgrade the working environment solely because the roadmap changed.
signals.stop_if: No current integration needs the capability, or migration would disrupt a working pinned runtime without measured benefit.
signals.runtime_fit: Roadmap/specification evidence only, not compatibility testing against either home node.
signals.reuse_notes: Read maintained specifications and implementations at exact versions. Code license review is still required before copying implementation.

commercial_evidence.detail: No external demand, revenue, or measured time saving established by these documentation reads.

signals.title: Reject more generic extraction investment until a customer advantage survives comparison
signals.fact: Firecrawl's current pricing page advertises 1,000 free credits per month and 1 credit per scraped page, with additional-feature costs. A listed price/free tier is not evidence of revenue or buyer retention.
signals.inference: A generic extract-text API is not an attractive default next product merely because payment infrastructure exists. Test a narrower buyer problem or avoid the build; this is a strategic inference, not proof that all extraction products are unviable.
signals.next_test: Use the existing opportunity-card gate to compare one real buyer task against this substitute and the no-build option. Seek a concrete repeat-use advantage before proposing a new paid endpoint.
signals.stop_if: An existing free/cheap tool performs the buyer task adequately, or no external user values the proposed difference.
signals.runtime_fit: No signup, paid request, customer contact or competitive performance test occurred. Pricing is a mutable September 5 Michigan-date observation.
signals.reuse_notes: Learn the product packaging and pricing pattern; do not copy code or assets without inspecting applicable licenses. Do not revive a previously rejected product based only on this card.

commercial_evidence.detail: Provider-published pricing only. External customer usage, willingness to pay, our margin and revenue remain unknown.
